annotations.title: Get development sale and rental transactions

description: Use this when a user asks for the full sale or rental history or past transactions of one Singapore development, such as "The Verve" or the HDB blocks on "Hougang Ave 10". Pass the URA project name as project; a shorter name contained in only one project name, such as "The Sail" for THE SAIL @ MARINA BAY, reads that project and nameMatch status "resolved" says so, while one that several or no project names contain returns nameMatch status "ambiguous" with the matching projects to retry with, or "unmatched"; for landed homes or a building without a project name, pass street, and homes "landed" for a landed house or "non_landed" for a condo or apartment, since one street can hold both; a condo street also needs its postal district, while a landed street without one covers the whole street, as the Homejourney valuation values it; for HDB, pass hdbStreet and optionally block; for a commercial or industrial property such as an office, shop or factory unit, pass commercialProject (the REALIS project name, or the street for units sold without one, as the Homejourney valuation names it) with its postal district. Returns recorded sales one page at a time with date, building address, floor, home type, sale type, area, price, and psf, plus the total count and pageUrl, the Homejourney page that shows the same records; for a project, facts adds its tenure, TOP year (the text calls only a year still to come expected; topStatus "not_announced" when URA lists it without one), total units and developer; pass record "rent" for rental contracts instead, where price is the monthly rent, private rentals give a size range (areaSqftRange) and bedrooms, and HDB rentals give the block and flat type. Filter with saleType and with minSqft and maxSqft (inclusive square feet, such as 900 to 1100 for units near a 1,000 sqft home; a private rental counts by the middle of its range), and order with sort. For HDB, filter by flatType; HDB rentals record no floor area, so they take flatType but not minSqft or maxSqft. HDB records and rentals do not support psf sorts. Commercial and industrial sales have no rental records, so they refuse record "rent". Use get_hdb_block_summary for HDB block price summaries and search_listings for live listings.
name: get_development_transactions
